payload.title: Spectral Analysis with Pyleoclim
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates the use of Pyleoclim for spectral analysis of paleoclimate data. It covers various spectral methods such as periodogram, Welch, MTM, Lomb-Scargle, and WWZ, and discusses the impact of pre-processing techniques like detrending and regridding on spectral analysis. The notebook uses the LR04 dataset, a Pliocene-Pleistocene stack of benthic δ18O records, to illustrate these methods. Outputs include plots of spectral density and significance tests to determine the significance of spectral peaks.
goals: Understand the various methods for spectral analysis accessible through Pyleoclim
Understand the effect of pre-processing on spectral analysis
Lisiecki, L. E., and Raymo, M. E. (2005), A Pliocene-Pleistocene stack of 57 globally distributed benthic δ18O records, Paleoceanography, 20, PA1003, doi:10.1029/2004PA001071.
